quotes.message:
Vehicle Make: Toyota - Lexus 
Vehicle Model: Prius - CT200 
Vehicle Year: 2016 - 2020
Pickup Location (US): Texas - Seattle
Destination Province: Herat
Additional Notes: Hello,
I need an exact quote for one FULL 40ft container shipment from Texas and Seattle, USA, to Herat / Islam Qalla, Afghanistan.

Cargo details:
- 4 vehicles (Toyota / Lexus sedan type)
- Auto parts inside the same container (doors, bumpers, headlights, wheels and other parts)

Please provide:

1. Full container price (not per vehicle)
2. Maximum number of vehicles allowed in a 40ft container
3. Additional charges for auto parts
4. Transit time
5. Customs, handling, and hidden charges
6. Insurance coverage details
7. Discount for full container shipment
8. Can the container be loaded privately under my name?
Also, if you have any cheaper or better shipping options for business customers, please let me know.
Please also explain the Afghanistan process after arrival:
Customs clearance process
Afghanistan complex/yard handling process
Delivery from Islam Qalla to Herat or other cities
Any taxes, storage fees, or additional local charges
I am planning for long-term business and would appreciate your best advice.
Thank you
quotes.name: Hamidullah Shabaan
